statement_refuted: Three nonzero bilinear cross-cycle strengths alone give a universal bounded-density estimate after allowing arbitrary scalar self-curvature on the same three independent active scalars.
counterexample: For independent U,V,W uniform on [-1/2,1/2], Q=(U+V+W)^2 has all three cross coefficients equal to 1 but unbounded density at 0. The coefficient matrix is the 3x3 all-ones matrix with spectrum {3,0,0}; hence this is not a counterexample to the full three-large-eigenvalue conjecture.
exact_check: The centered three-uniform sum has p_S(0)=3/4, so p_Q(t)=p_S(sqrt(t))/sqrt(t) ~ (3/4)t^(-1/2).
replacement_scope: A spectral gap for the full aggregate three-scalar compression, or an independent curved-bank payment, is required. QFORM-THREE-BANK-CURVED-SCALAR-COMPRESSION-v1 gives a valid gapped replacement.
